pie: nu pótnih₂ mléwHt. wíHre kúdʰe h₁és? nu só wérh₁yet. kl̥Héni wr̥ǵyóm. h₁eǵ ḱémh₂m̥. dʰéh₁mn̥ gʷm̥dʰí. puHróm h₁ddʰí. tóm pékʷom. dʰugh₂tḗr kúdʰe h₁ésti? séh₂ h₁n̥dóm sédyeti. pótnih₂ moy wéyh₁onm̥ dédh₃dʰi. wéyh₁onm̥ píph₃e bʰh₂dʰí-kʷe nu.
english: Then the wife said: "Husband, where were you?" Then he said: "I was working on the hill. I became tired." "Come to the house. Eat the grain. I cooked it." "Where is the daughter?" "She is sitting inside." "Wife, give me wine." "Drink the wine and speak now."

pie: h₁yós swéḱurosyo bʰardʰéh₂m skinédeti nu pénkʷe déh₃neh₂ dédeh₃tu. h₁yós dayh₂urés h₁óh₃s stunédeti nu tríns moysóns h₁opéyetu. h₁yós swēḱurósyo ǵénum bʰinédeti nu só ḱóymom linékʷtu. h₁yós bʰréh₂tr̥s h₂ómsm̥ Hrunépeti nu wéyh₁onm̥ bʰéretu. h₁yós h₃rḗǵnih₂m̥ stunédeti só mē gʷíh₃wet.
english: Whoever cuts off the beard of a father-in-law, then let him give five gifts. Whoever hits the mouth of a husband's brother, then let him give three rams. Whoever splits the jaw of a brother-in-law, then let him leave the village. Whoever breaks a brother's shoulder, then let him bring wine. Whoever strikes the queen, let him not live.

pie: yémHoh₁ h₃rḗǵn̥yeh₂ey h₁stés. nu bʰréh₂terh₁ h₂ukstā́m. tóh₁ ḱóymoy tḱitā́m. nu wĺ̥kʷos h₂énh₂tm̥ gʰrébh₂t. tóh₁ tóm kʷḱtā́m. nu tóh₁ tóm gʷʰn̥tā́m. h₃rḗǵnih₂ bʰréh₂tr̥bʰos déh₃rom bʰéret. nu h₂yéwHō néḱt. somHós gʷíh₃wet. só wr̥ǵyét. tósyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: The queen has twins. The two brothers grew up. They dwelt in the village. A wolf seized the duck. They saw it. They slew it. The queen gave a gift to the brothers. The young one vanished. The Alone One lived. He worked. His fame is imperishable.

pie: nu swésōr wérh₁yet. bʰréh₂ter tr̥syóh₂. wódr̥ moy h₁opéye. nu só h₂éǵt. swésor píph₃e. tód stéwdt. mē me stunéds. ne te stunédmi. h₂énh₂tm̥ spéḱye. séh₂ snéh₂ti. h₂énh₂tm̥ dedórḱh₂e. nu snéh₂eti. swésor dedwóyh₂e.
english: Then the sister said: "Brother, I am thirsty. Give me water." Then he said: "Drink, sister. It became cold." "Do not push me!" "I am not pushing you. Look at the duck! It is swimming." "I see the duck. Now let us swim." "Sister, I am afraid."

pie: nu gʰóstis wéwket. h₂éwsōs léwkt. nu h₁éymi. nu gʰóstipotis sékʷt. déh₃rom h₁áyso. déh₃rom toy méǵh₂ h₁ésti. dʰéh₁mn̥ toy meménoh₂. h₁éḱwōs toy HéHḱewes h₁sih₁ént. dʰéǵʰōm te méh₂tēr ph₂syéh₁t. nu só mléwHt. bʰréh₂ter gʷíh₃woyh₁s.
english: Then the guest said: "Dawn became bright. Now I am going." Then the master said: "Take the gift." "Your gift is great. I shall remember your house." "May your horses be swift. May Mother Earth protect you." Then he said: "Brother, may you live."

pie: gʷréh₂us h₂éǵrom kʷetwr̥bʰí gʷéwbʰis h₂éryet. nu só térmn̥ stnéh₂t. nu m̥h₂dh₂rós gʷr̥h₂éws suHnús h₁ésti. nu m̥h₂dh₂rós gʰórdʰom démet. miḱrós m̥h₂dh₂rṓd ǵeǵónh₁e. nu miḱrós dʰéh₁mn̥ déḱm̥t moysṓys kʷrinéh₂t. h₂élbʰit h₂wékst. nu miḱrós gʷréh₂wonm̥ tl̥néh₂t. nu só légʰt. dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr tóm ḱélet.
english: The Heavy One ploughed the field with four cattle. He placed the boundary. The Wet One is the son of the Heavy One. The Wet One built a hedge. The Mixed One is born from the Wet One. The Mixed One bought a house with ten rams. Barley grew. The Mixed One lifted the quern. Then he lay down. Mother Earth covered him.

pie: h₂ówis h₁ékʷoybʰyos wewked: "dʰǵʰémonm̥ spéḱyoh₂ h₁éḱwoms-kʷe h₂áǵeti, ḱḗr moy agʰnutor".
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: nu swéḱuros wérh₁t. snúse h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m bʰére. téh₂eh₁ woséyeso ǵʰéymn̥ h₁ésti. nu séh₂ mléwHt. swéḱure h₂óweyes kúdʰe h₁sénti? téh₂es kl̥Héni h₁sénti. moysós gʰórdʰe stestóh₂e. swéḱure dedwóyh₂e. wĺ̥kʷos h₂énti h₁ésti. snúse mē tréms. tā́s péh₂soh₂. tā́s h₁éymi.
english: Then the father-in-law said: "Daughter-in-law, bring the wool. Dress yourself with it; it is winter." Then she said: "Father-in-law, where are the sheep?" "They are on the hill. The ram stands by the hedge." "Father-in-law, I am afraid." "The wolf is near." "Daughter-in-law, do not tremble. I shall guard them." "I am going to them."

pie: ǵr̥h₂éntih₂ h₂ówins h₂mélǵt. nu dʰugh₂tḗr tósyeh₂s ǵeǵónh₁e. dʰugh₂tḗr h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m tl̥néh₂t. nu dʰugh₂tḗr téh₂eh₁ woséyeto. dʰugh₂tḗr dwipléh₂s méh₂tēr h₁ésti. nu dwipléh₂ puHróm pékʷet. dwipléh₂ swéḱurosyo snusós h₁ésti. nu séh₂ dʰéh₁mn̥ h₂lékset. ym̥tós dwipléh₂s dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ésti. ym̥tós moysóm h₂élet. ym̥tós légʰt nu dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr tā́m ḱélet.
english: The Old One milked the sheep. A daughter is born from her. The daughter lifted the wool. The daughter dressed herself. The daughter is the mother of the Double One. The Double One cooked the grain. The Double One is the daughter-in-law of the father-in-law. She protected the house. The Held One is the daughter of the Double One. The Held One nourished the ram. The Held One lay down; Mother Earth covered her.

pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: ḱwṓ h₁yósmōy h₁éseti tóm h₂életu. h₁yód ḱwṓ h₂nérm̥ gʷʰényēti nu ḱunés gʰóstipotis ḱóymoybʰos wéyh₁onm̥ bʰéretu. h₁yód ḱwṓ wĺ̥kʷom moréyēti só mudyéh₁t. h₁yód h₂nḗr ḱwónm̥ stunédeti nu tósyo gʰóstipoteyey moysóm dédeh₃tu. ḱwṓ moysóm péh₂stu mē-kʷe gʰrébh₂t wĺ̥kʷos tóm. ḱwṓ swēḱurósyo dʰéh₁mn̥ h₁n̥dó mē gʷémt. ḱwṓ ní l̥gʰyéh₁t.
english: Whoever has a dog, let him feed it. If a dog kills a man, then let the master of the dog bring wine to the kin. If a dog kills a wolf, may it be glad. If a man hits a dog, then let him give a ram to its master. Let the dog guard the ram, and let the wolf not seize it. Let the dog not step into the house of a brother-in-law. May the dog lie down.

pie: nu ḱluté h₃rḗǵs h₁yód dʰéh₁t. h₁yós gʷṓs stéh₂yēti nu déḱm̥t moysóns kʷéyetu. h₁yód bʰṓr h₁éḱwoh₁ h₂epó h₂éǵēti nu kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons kʷéyetu. h₁yód só gʷṓs ḱélēti widḗti-kʷe spéḱs tóm nu spéḱs tóm gʰrébh₂tu. h₁yós bʰórm̥ dʰh₁méni gʷʰéneti só mē kʷéyet. h₁yós moysóm bʰrés kʷrinéh₂eti nu dwís kʷéyetu.
english: Now hear what the king set down. Whoever steals cattle, then let him pay ten rams. If a thief drives two horses away, then let him pay four horses. If he hides the cattle and the watcher sees him, then let the watcher seize him. Whoever kills the thief in the house, let him not pay. Whoever buys a ram from a thief, then let him pay twice.

pie: ḱm̥tógus h₃réǵey déḱm̥t gʷṓs bʰéretu. h₂óweyes h₁yósmōy h₁ésonti h₃rḗǵn̥yeh₂ey h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₁opéyetu. HéHḱus h₁éḱwos h₁yósmōy h₁éseti h₃rḗǵn̥yeh₂s dʰugtréy tóm déwktu. h₁yós déh₃nom ḱélēti nu dwís kʷéyetu. gʷówes h₁yósmōy ne h₁ésonti nu déh₃nom h₁áytu. h₃rḗǵs h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁syéh₁t.
english: Let him who has a hundred cows bring the king ten cattle. Whoever has sheep, let him give the queen wool. Whoever has a swift horse, let him lead it to the queen's daughter. Whoever hides a gift, then let him pay twice. Whoever has no cattle, then let him give a gift. May the king be a giver of good things.

pie: h₁yós bʰoydʰéh₂m déh₃eti tā́m h₂léksetu. h₁yós bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti dyḗws ph₂tḗr tóm gʷʰn̥yéh₁t. dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr wékʷos ḱléwtu. sóh₂wl̥ bʰoydʰéh₂m spéḱyetu. h₁yód bʰréh₂terh₁ bʰéh₂etes nu bʰoydʰéh₂m dédh₃tām. h₁yós bʰoydʰéh₂m ḱléweti tā́m memóntu. bʰoydʰéh₂ sh₂imṓ h₁éstu.
english: Whoever gives a pledge, let him guard it. Whoever breaks the pledge, may Father Sky strike him down. Let Mother Earth hear the word. Let the sun look at the pledge. If two brothers speak, then let them give a pledge. Whoever hears the pledge, let him remember it. Let the pledge be a cord.

pie: "kʷíd wēlh₁si?"
english: "What do you want?"

pie: nu ph₂tḗr wérh₁t. dʰúgh₂ter h₂nḗr dʰéh₁mn̥ gʷémt. h₂isḱéti te. nu dʰugh₂tḗr sékʷt. kʷís h₁ésti? ḱm̥tógus h₁ésti. déḱm̥t dóh₃r̥h₂ h₁wédmn̥ h₁ésti. tóm ne ǵn̥néh₃mi. h₁wésus h₁ésti? nu só h₂éǵt. h₂yéwHō h₁ésti. tóm spéḱyōh₂. deywṓs toy h₁wésum h₂nérm̥ wédʰoyh₁ent.
english: Then the father said: "Daughter, a man came to the house. He is seeking you." Then the daughter said: "Who is he?" "He is one who has a hundred cows. Ten gifts are the bride-price." "I do not know him. Is he good?" Then he said: "He is young." "Let me look at him." "May the gods lead a good husband to you."

pie: ǵérh₂onts wékʷōs bʰéh₂t. nu deywṓs téh₂ ḱl̥wént. wiprós tósmōd ǵeǵónh₁e. nu wiprós deywóybʰos wékʷōs mléwHt. deywṓs mudént. nu puHyós wiprṓd ǵeǵónh₁e. tósyo h₁óh₃s h₂eḱróm h₁ést. nu puHyós sh₂wéney moysóm h₁opéyet. puHyós kl̥Héni sédyet. puHyós léytt.
english: The old man spoke words. The gods heard them. The Trembling One is born from him. The Trembling One spoke words to the gods. The gods became glad. The Pure One is born from the Trembling One. His mouth was sharp. The Pure One gave a ram to the sun. The Pure One sat on the hill. The Pure One went away.

pie: nu swéḱuros wérh₁yet. ǵḿ̥re méne wékʷos ḱludʰí. swēḱurṓd toy mē stunéds. snusṓy wódr̥ wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe wéǵʰe. deywóybʰos moysóm bʰére. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m mē klépes. nu só sékʷt. swéḱure ḱléwsoh₂. téh₂ meménoh₂. nu swéḱuros wérh₁t. ǵḿ̥re dʰéh₁mn̥ h₂lékse. ǵḿ̥re gʷíh₃woyh₁s.
english: Then the father-in-law said: "Son-in-law, hear my words. Do not strike your brother-in-law. Carry water and wine to the daughter-in-law. Bring a ram to the gods. Do not steal wool." Then he said: "I am listening, father-in-law. I shall remember them." Then the father-in-law said: "Guard the house, son-in-law. Son-in-law, may you live."

pie: wĺ̥kʷos h₂ówins gʰrébh₂t. nu bélos tóm gʷʰént. só tā́s spért. nu dʰegʷʰrós bélosyo suHnús h₁sté. dʰegʷʰrós bʰórm̥ lémbʰt. nu bʰṓr bʰéyh₂t. dʰegʷʰrós tóm ḱóymom wédʰet. nu slih₃wós dʰegʷʰrṓd ǵeǵónh₁e. slih₃wós h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. slih₃wósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti.
english: A wolf seized the sheep. The Strong One slew it. He rescued the sheep. The Burning One is the son of the Strong One. The Burning One seized the thief. The thief became afraid. The Burning One led him to the village. The Blue One is born from the Burning One. The Blue One slew the serpent. The name of the Blue One is famous.

pie: h₁yós wiHróm moréyēti nu mr̥wósyo ḱóymōs déḱm̥t déh₃reh₂ sléh₂gʷontor. h₁yód ḱóymōs tóns ne sléh₂gʷontor nu gʷʰonós mértu. h₁yós ḱóymom gʷʰéneti ph₂wéni mē sédt. h₁yód bʰréh₂tēr bʰréh₂term̥ gʷʰényēti nu spéḱs gʷʰonóm dʰh₁méns h₁éǵʰs wédʰetu. mr̥wṓys ǵʰémi ḱéyih₁to. tósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁syéh₁t.
english: Whoever kills a man, then let the kin of the dead man take ten gifts. If the kin do not take them, then let the striker die. Whoever kills one of the kin, let him not sit at the fire. If a brother kills a brother, then let the watcher lead the striker out of the house. May the dead man lie in the earth. May his name be famous.

pie: h₁yós márkom kʷrinéh₂eti nu márkosyo h₁óh₃s spéḱyetu. wósn̥ wéǵʰetu. h₁yós wéyh₁onm̥ kʷrinéh₂eti nu dóh₃r̥ dédeh₃tu. h₁yód bʰréh₂terh₁ dʰéh₁mn̥ kʷrinéh₂etes nu déḱm̥t moysóns kʷéyetām. h₁yós wósn̥ ne h₁áyeti tóm ne lémbʰeti. wesós ḱóymoy h₁syéh₁t. spéḱs wékʷos bʰéh₂tu.
english: Whoever buys a horse, then let him look at the mouth of the horse. Let him carry the price. Whoever buys wine, then let him give a gift. If two brothers buy a house, then let them pay ten rams. Whoever does not give the price, he shall not seize it. May there be selling in the village. Let the watcher speak the word.

pie: térmn̥ gʰórdʰos h₁éstu. h₁yós térmn̥ Hyowdʰéyēti nu só ḱóymom linékʷtu. h₁yós gʰórdʰom skinédeti nu déh₃rom déh₃tu. h₁yós bʰréh₂tr̥s h₂éǵrom h₁n̥dó gʷémeti h₂élbʰit mē h₁édt. kólHō mórǵs h₁éstu. gʰórdʰos dwóh₁ h₂éǵroh₁ h₁entér stéh₂tu. ḱm̥tógus mórǵm̥ déyḱetu. térmn̥ sth₂éh₁yoyh₁t.
english: Let the boundary be a hedge. Whoever moves the boundary, then let him leave the village. Whoever cuts off the hedge, then let him give a gift. Whoever comes into a brother's field, let him not eat the barley. Let a hill be the border. Let a hedge stand between two fields. Let the man with a hundred cows point out the border. May the boundary stand.

pie: bʰruHrós moysóns kólHonm̥ ǵʰéyt. nu h₁léngʰus bʰruHrósyo suHnús h₁ésti. h₁léngʰus h₂ówins déwkt h₂mélǵt-kʷe tā́s. nu somHós h₁ln̥gʷʰéws ǵeǵónh₁e. somHós dʰéh₁mn̥ démet. nu só wĺ̥kʷom gʷʰényet. méǵh₂ ḱléwos tóm sékʷeto. nu só mért nu tósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti. solh₂wós somHósyo dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ésti. solh₂wós h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wésto. nu tóy ḱlutṓs h₁sénti.
english: The Brown One drove the rams to the hill. The Nimble One is the son of the Brown One. The Nimble One led the sheep, and he milked them. The Alone One is born from the Nimble One. The Alone One built a house. Then he killed the wolf. Great fame followed him. He died; now his name is famous. The Whole One is the daughter of the Alone One. She wore wool. Now they are famous.

pie: nu h₃rḗǵnih₂ wérh₁yet. h₃réǵ dwóh₁ wiHróh₁ dʰéh₁mn̥ gʷm̥tā́m. dʰugh₂térm̥ nos h₂isḱónti. nu só sékʷt. kʷís h₁sénti? ǵérh₂onts ḱm̥tógus h₁ésti. h₁léngʰewes h₁éḱwōs h₂yuHnéy h₁sénti. dʰugh₂tḗr nos tóh₁ spéḱyetu. nu séh₂ bʰéh₂tu. nu h₃rḗǵnih₂ wéwket. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr tósyeh₂ey wiHróm wédʰoyh₁t.
english: Then the queen said: "King, two men came to the house. They are seeking our daughter." Then he said: "Who are they?" "The old man has a hundred cows. The young man has nimble horses." "Let our daughter look at them." "Then let her speak." Then the queen said: "May Dawn, the daughter of Sky, lead a husband to her."

pie: nu dʰugh₂tḗr wéwket. kʷís sóh₂wl̥ dyéwi dʰéh₁t? nu só wérh₁yet. deywṓs tód dʰh₁ént. kʷíd wódr̥ píph₃eti ne-kʷe pléh₁t tód. dʰéǵʰōm tód píph₃eti ne-kʷe pléh₁t séh₂. kʷíd kl̥Héni ḱéytor ne-kʷe Hyowdʰéyetor tód. térmn̥ kl̥Héni ḱéytor ne-kʷe Hyowdʰéyetor tód. kʷíd h₁rudʰéh₁ti? péh₂wr̥ h₁rudʰéh₁ti. ph₂tér túH wóydth₂e.
english: Then the daughter said: "Who put the sun in the sky?" Then he said: "The gods put it." "What drinks water and does not become full?" "The earth drinks it, and it does not become full." "What lies on the hill and does not move?" "The boundary lies on the hill and does not move." "What is red?" "Fire is red." "You know, father."

pie: ǵérh₂onts h₃rḗǵs h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. nu méǵh₂ ḱléwos tóm sékʷeto. tósyo suHnús h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁ésti. nu déh₃tōr deywóybʰos ḱóymoybʰos-kʷe dóh₃r̥h₂ déh₃t. h₁léwdʰeros dh₃trés ǵeǵónh₁e. nu h₁léwdʰeros kʷetwórn̥s HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵet. h₁léwdʰeros pótnih₂m̥ wédʰet. nu tóysōm dʰugh₂tḗr gʷr̥h₂éws méh₂tēr h₁ésti. gʷréh₂us h₃rḗǵs bʰúHt. gʷréh₂us dʰugtréy h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t. gʷréh₂us mért nu tósyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: The old king slew the serpent. Great fame followed him. His son is a giver of good things. The giver gave gifts to the gods and to the kin. The Free One is born from the giver. The Free One drove four swift horses. The Free One took a wife. Their daughter is the mother of the Heavy One. The Heavy One became king. The Heavy One set a name for the daughter. The Heavy One died; his fame is imperishable.

pie: dwóh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ pl̥th₂enṓy h₁stā́m. nu h₁éḱwoh₁ HéHḱuh₁ h₁stā́m. pl̥th₂enós tóh₁ h₂élet. nu bʰérǵʰus pl̥th₂enósyo suHnús h₁ésti. bʰérǵʰus tóh₁ kʷékʷlom yunégt. nu h₂eḱrós bʰr̥ǵʰéws ǵeǵónh₁e. h₂eḱrós márkom h₂éǵet. nu só h₂élbʰit wéǵʰet. méǵh₂ ḱléwos tóm h₂eh₂nóḱe. só légʰt. h₁éḱwōm h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti.
english: The Wide One had two horses. The two horses were swift. The Wide One nourished them. The High One is the son of the Wide One. The High One joined them to the wheel. The Sharp One is born from the High One. The Sharp One drove a horse. He carried the barley. Great fame has reached him. He lay down. The name of the horses is famous.

english: The guest arrived at the house. Then the master spoke: "Who are you?" "Where are you going?" Then he said: "I am going to my brother. Now I became tired. Let me sit by your fire." Then the master said: "Sit down inside. Drink water. Guest, do not be afraid. May Dawn give you good things."
